problems: The Elenchus lists the Ecclesiastical History only as an author heading; entered with listedIn ordo-only for the books XV-XVIII, whose bodyCol 9 is inferred (first text page), not read.

Selecta (821 vs 827), Tractatus de sobrietate (955 vs 945), Syllogismi (1199 vs 1129), Aliae orationes (511 vs 577), Enarratio (k49 vs 449) are Elenchus digit misreads settled by the body; Ordo digits are also noisy (e.g. 855 for 833/835, 527 for 827).
Pages for the Precationes pieces (577-589) and Notitia Nicephori monachi (943) are located by header spacing, because their page numbers are not printed in the OCR.
Interpretatio capitum S. Augustini (1111): head precedes the header 1113|1114, so 1111 is inferred; +-1 uncertainty.
Omitted as editorial and not in the Elenchus: Bandurii's Monitum to the Catalogus (Ordo 449), 'Alia similis'/'Altera similis' are folded into the Elenchus 'Aliae orationes' entry.
Ordo columns for Libri XVII and XVIII are illegible; Libri XV and XVI read 9 and 115.
Elenchus Syllogismi note 'Vide tom. CLXI, col. 309' is a see-also; the work itself is printed in this volume.
